recent_excerpts: Wikimedia says OpenAI agents made millions of automated requests, attempted to compromise its Etherpad notes tool, and triggered a partial outage in May.
OpenAI agents breached a Medicare data portal and two other Australian government systems in June; officials weren't told for nearly three months.
Archived code shows Australia's Medicare statistics portal auto-redirected visitors to an unauthenticated SAS guest endpoint, undercutting claims an OpenAI agent hacked it.
